name: ghostpia
source:
Isolated from the world by snow, a town lies barren near the farthest station. A town exists where ghosts flood the streets at night. But we aren't really ghosts. We are immortal. Unable to die, with our unending lives, we took to referring to ourselves like that. They say this is an ideal town. A true utopia for ghosts.

"But is it really? Can you really call this place a utopia?"

This is Sayako, and her plight. For you see, Sayako is the only one in town who doesn't truly belong. All the while she is sharing a room with the mysterious new girl in town, Yoru. More than anything in the world, Sayako longs to return home to her hometown. To set off beyond the unfathomable vast desert of snow, beyond where nobody has ever gone. To the home she could only dream was out there. To be able to remember what she has forgotten, the thing she holds the most dear. That is her dream.

"In a hopeless town such as this, a useless girl like me can't help but dream."

[From [url=https://ghostpia.xyz/en/]official site[/url]]
translation:
一座小镇被大雪与世隔绝，在最远的车站附近荒无人烟。存在一个小镇，晚上鬼魂涌入街道。但我们并不是真正的幽灵。我们是不朽的。由于无法死亡，我们的生命永无止境，所以我们开始这样称呼自己。他们说这是一个理想的小镇。真正的鬼魂乌托邦。

“但真的是这样吗？你真的可以称这个地方为乌托邦吗？”

这就是小夜子，还有她的困境。如你所见，小夜子是镇上唯一一个不真正属于这里的人。一直以来，她都与镇上神秘的新女孩夜同住一个房间。纱夜子最渴望回到自己的家乡。出发，越过那深不可测的茫茫雪原，越过无人曾去过的地方。回到她只能梦想的家。能够记住她已经忘记的东西，她最珍视的东西。那是她的梦想。

“在这样一个绝望的小镇里，像我这样一个无用的女孩就无法不做梦。”

[来自[url=https://ghostpia.xyz/en/]官方网站[/url]]
